name: File Browser
desc: Fast web file manager: browse, upload, edit and share files with links. From the RSRB repository.
note: Sign in as admin – the first password is in the installation output and in /var/lib/filebrowser/initial-password. Its root folder is set in /etc/default/filebrowser.

name: Transmission
desc: BitTorrent download manager with a web UI. Downloads straight to the NAS.
note: Login: transmission / transmission – change it in /etc/transmission-daemon/settings.json (stop the service first).
setup: systemctl stop transmission-daemon; sed -i 's/"rpc-whitelist-enabled": true/"rpc-whitelist-enabled": false/' /etc/transmission-daemon/settings.json; systemctl start transmission-daemon

name: MiniDLNA
desc: Media server: movies, music and photos show up on TVs and consoles on your network.
note: Add your media folders to /etc/minidlna.conf (media_dir=/volume1/…), then restart the service.

name: Mosquitto
desc: MQTT broker for smart home devices and sensors (port 1883).
note: Listens on localhost only by default. For the network add a 'listener 1883' in /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/.

name: FTP server
desc: File access over FTP for scanners, cameras and older devices (port 21).
note: Sign in with the NAS users. To allow uploads set write_enable=YES in /etc/vsftpd.conf.
